single_input_comparison.interpretation:
Same recorded single-robot inputs, frozen V5 vs current reference functions.

No wall deadline is imposed in this algebraic regression check. It does not
prove closed-loop reproducibility or erase a failed actual repeat.
single_input_comparison.source_directory: /home/gdut/24_LC/turtlebot3_consensus_cbf_ws/四脚本对比证据/双机器人绕行_2026-11-12/single_v5_regression

limits: Current 4/4 covers two-robot CV line scenarios only; development seeds 211/239 not unseen validation
17 trials include baseline and earlier failures; do not report all attempts as successes
Single V5 repeats both failed continuous motion; algebraic equality under 400 same-input frames is not closed-loop stability or reproducibility
Prefix-only references do not certify the failed/unverified 8s tail; original N10 hard constraints remain revalidated
All peers use local scan fits and odometry short predictions; no raw scans or future plans shared
Circle/swept proxies and first-step checks are not exact mesh, continuous physical safety or recursive feasibility proofs
No five-robot, curved formation, localization drift or physical deployment validation
